partitions.confirm_end_rationale: Fundamentals/valuations AVAILABLE_AT end at 2025-03-18; confirmation cannot use later undated info

multiple_testing.cycle_fdr: Benjamini-Hochberg alpha=0.05 across the four discovery p-values

EXP-FUND-01.title: Post-earnings drift
EXP-FUND-01.hypothesis_plain: After a company reports materially better or worse business results, does the stock continue moving in the same direction for some time?
EXP-FUND-01.hypothesis: Stocks with the highest YoY basic_EPS surprise at official earnings AVAILABLE_AT outperform the lowest-surprise cohort over a 21-session hold after CNC costs when entered at the next session after AVAILABLE_AT.
EXP-FUND-01.null_hypothesis: No positive cost-aware post-earnings drift using YoY EPS surprise; any gross gap is noise or destroyed by costs.
EXP-FUND-01.event_definition: EARNINGS_RESULT rows from pit_events with matching PIT fundamentals row (symbol + available_at)
EXP-FUND-01.fundamental_change_definition: YoY basic_eps change = (eps_t - eps_{t-4q}) / max(|eps_{t-4q}|, 0.01) for Quarterly consolidated-preferring series; requires prior comparable quarter with earlier available_at
EXP-FUND-01.entry_timing: ALWAYS next trading session strictly after available_at date (conservative; no same-bar / same-day trade even if released during hours)
EXP-FUND-01.portfolio: long top surprise quintile / short bottom surprise quintile among events with valid surprise in the partition
EXP-FUND-01.benchmark: equal-weight of all valid-surprise events in the same partition window (descriptive)

EXP-FUND-02.title: Quality / profitability
EXP-FUND-02.hypothesis_plain: Do financially stronger and more profitable companies produce better future risk-adjusted returns?
EXP-FUND-02.hypothesis: Highest net-profit-margin quintile (PAT/Revenue from latest PIT fundamentals as of formation) outperforms lowest quintile on 21d forward returns after CNC costs.
EXP-FUND-02.null_hypothesis: No positive cost-aware quality edge using PAT/Revenue.
EXP-FUND-02.quality_metric: net_margin = profit_after_tax / revenue_from_operations when revenue_from_operations > 0; else missing
EXP-FUND-02.portfolio: long high margin / short low margin
EXP-FUND-02.benchmark: equal-weight universe of names with valid margin on formation date

EXP-FUND-03.title: Earnings growth
EXP-FUND-03.hypothesis_plain: Do companies whose earnings are improving faster subsequently outperform?
EXP-FUND-03.hypothesis: Highest YoY basic_EPS growth quintile (from latest PIT fundamentals as of formation) outperforms lowest quintile on 21d forward returns after CNC costs.
EXP-FUND-03.growth_metric: Same YoY basic_eps formula as EXP-FUND-01, evaluated cross-sectionally at formation dates (not event-entry)
EXP-FUND-03.portfolio: long high YoY EPS growth / short low
EXP-FUND-03.benchmark: equal-weight names with valid YoY EPS growth

EXP-FUND-04.title: Value / trailing PE
EXP-FUND-04.hypothesis_plain: Do cheaper companies, measured using information actually known at the time, outperform more expensive companies?
EXP-FUND-04.hypothesis: Lowest trailing-PE quintile outperforms highest trailing-PE quintile on 21d forward returns after CNC costs using PIT valuations available_ts <= formation date.
EXP-FUND-04.null_hypothesis: No positive cost-aware value edge using trailing PE.
EXP-FUND-04.negative_earnings_rule: rows with pe<=0 excluded (ledger already stores pe>0 only); missing PE excluded
EXP-FUND-04.outlier_rule: exclude pe > 200 at formation (preregistered hard cap; not fit on outcomes)
EXP-FUND-04.portfolio: long low PE / short high PE
